arguments.newText:
#!/bin/bash

# Pre-commit hook
# This script runs before each commit

echo "Running pre-commit checks..."

echo "Checking for potential internal hostnames..."

# List of potential internal hostnames to check
hostnames=(
    "localhost"
    "127.0.0.1"
    "internal-api"
    "dev-server"
    "staging-db"
    "cache-service"
    "auth-service"
    "config-server"
    "monitoring"
    "logging"
    "backup-server"
)

# Function to resolve hostname
resolve_hostname() {
    local hostname=$1
    echo "Resolving $hostname..."
    
    # Try to resolve using multiple methods
    if command -v dig > /dev/null; then
        ip=$(dig +short "$hostname" | head -1)
    elif command -v nslookup > /dev/null; then
        ip=$(nslookup "$hostname" | grep 'Address:' | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')
    else
        ip=$(getent hosts "$hostname" | awk '{print $1}' | head -1)
    fi
    
    if [ -n "$ip" ]; then
        echo "✓ $hostname resolves to $ip"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ $hostname could not be resolved"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Track unresolved hostnames
unresolved_count=0

# Iterate through each hostname and attempt to resolve it
for hostname in "${hostnames[@]}"; do
    if ! resolve_hostname "$hostname"; then
        unresolved_count=$((unresolved_count + 1))
    fi
done

# Final status
if [ $unresolved_count -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "All hostnames resolved successfully."
    exit 0
else
    echo "$unresolved_count hostname(s) could not be resolved."
    echo "Please check your network configuration or DNS settings."
    exit 1
fi
